author: Ben O'Bro & JackCY (mod); Birkin re-tune for Giovann Adonis
description:
A 2013 Birkin S3 Lotus Seven replica, British Racing Green, as it stands in October 2026: Ford Kent crossflow 1600 bored to 1700, low compression pistons, twin side-draught carbs, wrapped exhaust manifolds, 4-speed Ford gearbox, live axle, open differential, right hand drive.

Re-tuned from the Caterham 1700 Super Sprint RHD mod. Engine: Ford 711M block bored to 1700, gas-flowed head, performance cam, low compression pistons, twin side-draughts. Assumptions (no dyno sheet yet): about 68 bhp (51 kW) at 6,000 rpm and 86 Nm at 5,250 rpm at the crank, a cammed Kent that is weak below about 4,500 rpm and comes on at 5,000 rpm, 6,800 rpm limiter, gear ratios 2.55 / 1.75 / 1.40 / 1.10 with the 3.92 final drive, 650 kg with driver, rear springs softened with less bump travel because the real car bottoms out at the rear at Killarney. Model, sound, tyres and brakes are the original mod's.

Real car reference: Killarney 14 Oct 2026, best lap 1:58.3, top speed 146 km/h on a 140 limit, 80 to 130 km/h in about 9 s.
name: Birkin S3 1700 Kent (Giovann)
